# Conformance vectors of version 1 of the canonical encodings of a template's compatibility key,
# nvx::host::template::TemplateKey, and of a capture class, nvx::host::template::CaptureClass,
# which the module nvx::host::template describes. README.md describes the line format and the
# rules that the vectors follow.
#
# KEY|NAME|BYTES|IDENTITY
#   The canonical encoding of a key, and its identity: the SHA-256 digest of "nvx template key", a
#   NUL byte, and the encoding. A decoder must decode the bytes, and an encoder must encode the key
#   that they hold to the same bytes.
# CLASS|NAME|BYTES|IDENTITY
#   The canonical encoding of a class, and its identity: the SHA-256 digest of "nvx capture class",
#   a NUL byte, and the encoding.
# INVALID_KEY_VERSION|NAME|BYTES
#   A key of another version of the encoding, which every decoder refuses as unsupported.
# INVALID_KEY|NAME|BYTES
#   Bytes that every decoder of a key must refuse.
#
# The keys and classes are those of the captures that tests/fixtures/template/README.md
# describes, with the OpenVMM, kernel, and initramfs identities sha256:a..., sha256:b..., and
# sha256:c..., the guest build guest-build-1, boot contract 3, control contract
# nvx-microvm-v2-control-v2, control session 1, snapshot format 6, device-state schema 1, time
# ABI 1, restore packet 4, and activation contract 1.
# The key of the template of a KVM microVM of 2 processors, all online at boot, and 512 MiB
# of RAM, of a capacity of 2 GiB, with a distro of 1 GiB, a scratch of 64 MiB, the dormant
# filesystem slot, a console, a control console, and no NIC, on the CPU profile
# intel.icelake-sp.v1, whose digest is 32 bytes of 5a and whose effective CPUID is the bytes
# 00 to 57: the capture of tests/fixtures/template/platform-kvm.
KEY|TEMPLATE||81901eda9602b4f2099c44415b7a38b035ff215b9bc50f860c8c70ca2c6f593f
# The same with a fixed NIC at 10.0.0.2/24, with its IPv6 identity, under an allow-list
# policy whose digest is 32 bytes of 07, and the invariant settings isolation.seccomp=strict
# and limits.pids=512.
KEY|NETWORK||f7418d9454a78af64bc5bc46e82206ccd085baf64cf7140e5ae4faf04b7c1ebe
# TEMPLATE on the host profile intel.host.v1.
KEY|HOST_PROFILE||93afa8bdde64df606707f5534c58420b92888acbbb6c8245e83006768c3ac940
# A machine of one processor and one device, and no NIC, which the invalid vectors change.
KEY|MINIMAL||d79a8fefc401da8568586cdc595a93a7e6c988aefbc62b03038901940211c1f1

# The class of the capture of TEMPLATE: the CPU profile auto, and 2 processors, all online at
# boot.
CLASS|TEMPLATE||b53b0169db5d983b31f24bec900cd0b962d26f12480d90803f21ae1d5c3ff334
# The class of the capture of NETWORK, whose NIC the capture attaches under the complete
# deny-all policy, whatever the policy of the class's network, here one that allows egress.
CLASS|NETWORK||2f32edae7e9eb532625af600232c68aa78b92e02c8116cb49f857f13ff5fcc7c

# MINIMAL in other versions of the encoding.
INVALID_KEY_VERSION|VERSION_0|
INVALID_KEY_VERSION|VERSION_2|
INVALID_KEY_VERSION|VERSION_65535|

# No bytes.
INVALID_KEY|EMPTY|
# MINIMAL without its last byte.
INVALID_KEY|TRUNCATED|
# MINIMAL and a byte after it.
INVALID_KEY|TRAILING_BYTE|
# A command line whose digest does not match it.
INVALID_KEY|COMMAND_LINE_DIGEST|
# A backend that does not exist.
INVALID_KEY|UNKNOWN_BACKEND|
# A device range of an address space that does not exist.
INVALID_KEY|UNKNOWN_ADDRESS_SPACE|
# An interrupt delivery mode that is not UTF-8.
INVALID_KEY|INTERRUPT_MODE_NOT_UTF8|
# A NIC whose presence tag is 2.
INVALID_KEY|PRESENCE_TAG_2|
# A NIC whose policy's enforcement is 2.
INVALID_KEY|BOOLEAN_2|
# Invariant settings out of the order of their names.
INVALID_KEY|UNSORTED_SETTINGS|
# An invariant setting named twice.
INVALID_KEY|DUPLICATE_SETTINGS|
# An invariant setting whose name holds an uppercase letter.
INVALID_KEY|UPPERCASE_SETTING|
# More APIC IDs than a microVM has processors.
INVALID_KEY|TOO_MANY_APIC_IDS|
# 3 processors, which a microVM cannot have.
INVALID_KEY|THREE_PROCESSORS|
# RAM ranges that do not hold the RAM.
INVALID_KEY|MEMORY_RANGES|
# A machine without devices.
INVALID_KEY|NO_DEVICES|
# A device ID twice.
INVALID_KEY|DUPLICATE_DEVICE|
# A filesystem slot that is not the dormant slot of version 1.
INVALID_KEY|SLOT_VERSION_0|
# A filesystem slot without a tag.
INVALID_KEY|EMPTY_TAG|
# A distro whose logical block size is 256.
INVALID_KEY|DISTRO_BLOCK_SIZE|
# An OpenVMM identity that holds a space.
INVALID_KEY|ARTIFACT_WITH_SPACE|
# A CPU profile of revision 0.
INVALID_KEY|CPU_PROFILE_REVISION_0|
# An effective CPUID that is not whole entries of 44 bytes.
INVALID_KEY|CPUID_LENGTH|
